title: Use a query default
summary: Spring Boot: Use a query default. Visit /page?n=3.
introduction: @RequestParam reads a query value. GET /page without n uses the default 1.
learningObjectives: Use a query default with Spring Boot

blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save one example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. JBang downloads the dependency on the //DEPS line. Use http://127.0.0.1:8080 and stop the server before another example.

blocks.title: Use a query default

blocks.text: The missing query input is replaced by defaultValue 1 and parsed as an int.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Text that cannot become an int is rejected before this method runs.
